**Overview**  
Pacific Seri Freight Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited logistics firm based in Selangor that specialises in cold‑chain transport and storage of frozen goods. The company was incorporated on 8 June 2007 and has a share capital of RM 5,000,000. It is governed by two directors, with the top shareholder owning 70 % of the equity. The firm has been involved in one legal case, acting as the plaintiff, and no financial statements are on record.
